layer1.name: LedgerLift
layer1.one_liner: Bank-feed reconciliation for bookkeepers handling 20+ small-business clients.
layer1.description: A reconciliation layer that sits on top of existing accounting software and clears the repetitive month-end matching work bookkeepers do by hand across many client books.
layer1.outcome_note: Synthetic fixture. Not a real company and not counted toward separation statistics.

layer2.pins: The cap releasing. Primary conversations cover the load-bearing assumptions, Evidence Quality lands around 81, the cap rises above the weighted mean and stops binding — so the composite is set by the evidence rather than by the ceiling. Also pins that one uncovered assumption (competition) still drags both Evidence Quality and its own sub-score.

assumptions.statement: Bookkeepers with 20+ client books spend more than 6 hours per month-end on manual transaction matching

falsification_criterion.applies_to: independent bookkeepers managing 20 or more client books
falsification_criterion.observation: walk through their last month-end close and time the matching step
falsification_criterion.metric: count who spent 6+ hours on manual matching

assumptions.statement: Bookkeeping practices already pay for at least one per-seat tool above $40/month

falsification_criterion.applies_to: independent bookkeeping practices with 2 or more staff
falsification_criterion.observation: ask them to list their current software line items and cost
falsification_criterion.metric: count already paying above $40/seat/month for a workflow tool

assumptions.statement: At least 2 in 10 bookkeepers contacted through accounting-software partner directories reply to a cold outreach

falsification_criterion.applies_to: independent bookkeepers listed in accounting-software partner directories
falsification_criterion.observation: cold outreach to 30 listed practices and measure reply rate
falsification_criterion.metric: count of replies leading to a conversation

assumptions.statement: The incumbent accounting platforms will not ship equivalent multi-client matching within 18 months

falsification_criterion.applies_to: the two dominant small-business accounting platforms
falsification_criterion.observation: track their public roadmaps and partner-conference announcements

assumptions.statement: The founder can get at least 2 warm introductions to practising bookkeepers per week without paid channels

falsification_criterion.observation: request introductions and count those that convert to a call
falsification_criterion.metric: count of warm introductions converting to a call
